description: This PHP source file defines the SearchDefsDocumentifier class, which converts SugarCRM/SuiteCRM bean objects into searchable document formats using a configurable search definitions framework. It includes methods for retrieving and caching field mappings, parsing bean properties, and integrating with logging and mapping utilities.

classes.name: SearchDefsDocumentifier
classes.description: A class responsible for converting SugarBean objects into searchable document formats based on search definitions.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean object into a map suitable for indexing, applying transformations and mappings.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the list of fields to index for a given module by parsing search definitions.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndexCached
methods.description: Caches and retrieves the field list for each module to avoid repeated parsing.

methods.name: parseBeans
methods.description: Extracts specified properties from the SugarBean object into an associative array for indexing.
